text:
jamal_sales: Heads-up 1 - Prospect (Helix Financial) sent over their enterprise auth checklist. key asks: strict single-tenant provisioning, domain ownership verification tied to SCIM claims, RBAC mapping with custom role names, SAML identity binding proof for audit, and proof of SSO enforcement at the proxy layer.
presales_rachael: tl;dr: they want to prevent cross-tenant signups with shared corporate domains (e.g., partners@helix.co should not get into different tenant). they also asked for SCIM scoping: one idp mapping -> one redwood tenant only.
se_omar: For domain verification we offer DNS TXT or email confirmation. for their requirement (auto-claim on first login only for verified domains) we can do DNS TXT + verify MX if org prefers mail-based.
idp_admin_tokyo: question from Helix: their Okta setup uses nested groups extensively. can Redwood map nested AD groups to our roles and preserve attributes like employeeNumber?
infra_eng: nested groups supported via our SCIM adapter when using Graph API or Okta SCIM with "expand=members" option. attributes: we map custom attributes if IdP includes them in the SAML assertion or SCIM user schema. we'll include employeeNumber in the user object and in audit events.
security_bot: note: provisioning and SSO events include assertion_id, assertion_issuer, and the SAML <AuthnStatement> timestamp. retention default 90d; can request export or extended retention add-on.
jamal_sales: pricing for POC (4 weeks, 2000 MAUs) - they asked if domain verification and SCIM delta-sync are included or add-ons.
presales_rachael: POC: feature flags enabled, SCIM delta available as beta with no extra charge for trial; domain verification included. audit retention add-on applies if >90 days. for enterprise GA, SCIM + domain verification included on Enterprise plan; extended retention billed separately.
idp_admin_tokyo: they want a sample SCIM mapping that prevents provisioning into non-mapped tenants and logs the source idp group.
se_omar: sample mapping snippet:```json
{"mappings":[{"idp_group":"HELIX\u005cEngineering","tenant":"helix-eng","role":"editor","preserve_attributes":["employeeNumber","department"]},{"idp_group":"HELIX\u005cAdmins","tenant":"helix-core","role":"admin"}]}
```

infra_eng: Implementation detail: we attach a provisioning context header (X-Prov-Context) on each SCIM operation capturing origin mapping id, idp_group, and request id. that header is recorded in audit logs to link event -> mapping.
legal_ops: small flag: we need to ensure the sec questionnaire answer on data residency clarifies where audit logs are stored for Private. I'll add the language.
jamal_sales: timeline: they want SSO+SCIM in 5 business days. is that feasible?
se_omar: yes for initial SCIM flow (provision/create) and SAML SSO via metadata import. delta-sync depends on Okta change token support; if missing we'll use paged polling every 4h for the POC.
presales_rachael: action items: @se_omar provide sample SAML metadata + SCIM mapping, @infra_eng document X-Prov-Context header and retention options, @legal_ops update questionnaire language, @jamal_sales prep kickoff calendar.
security_bot: created ticket INF-4273 for extended retention discussion.
jamal_sales: thanks everyone. I'll send the questionnaire back tomorrow and set kickoff for next Mon. :calendar:
